title: 7075, 7050, and 6061 in Aerospace: Where Each Alloy Earns Its Place
summary: Compare aerospace plate purchasing requirements for 6061, 7075 and 7050, including temper, certification, grain direction and machining allowance.
body_markdown:
## 6061: general components and tooling


6061 combines moderate strength, corrosion resistance and weldability. Plate used for machined fixtures, brackets and housings commonly carries a T651 designation. A 6061 extrusion and a blank sawn from plate are different product forms; confirm the drawing’s form and temper rather than treating them as equivalent because the dimensions match.


[6061-T651 aluminum plate: sizes and pricing](https://noxmetals.co/materials/6061-aluminum)[Kaiser Aluminum: 6061 technical data](https://online.kaiseraluminum.com/depot/PublicProductInformation/Document/1015/Kaiser_Aluminum_6061_Sheet_Coil_and_Plate.pdf)


## 7075: high-strength components


7075 is used where high strength relative to weight matters. The corrosion environment and loading direction influence the temper requirement. A drawing calling for T7351 should not be fulfilled with T651 just because both pieces are 7075. Check the material certificate against the complete callout.


[7075 aluminum plate: T651 and T7351 sizes](https://noxmetals.co/materials/7075-aluminum)[Kaiser Aluminum: 7075 technical data](https://online.kaiseraluminum.com/depot/PublicProductInformation/Document/1017/Kaiser_Aluminum_7075_Sheet_Coil_and_Plate.pdf)


## 7050: thick aerospace plate


7050 combines strength, toughness and corrosion performance for aerospace structural plate. It has a different chemistry from 7075, including a higher specified copper range; it is not simply a lower-copper version of 7075. T7451 and T7651 remain distinct requirements, and AMS 4050 identifies T7451 plate.


[7050-T7451 aluminum plate: sizes and pricing](https://noxmetals.co/materials/7050-aluminum)[SAE: AMS 4050, 7050-T7451 plate](https://saemobilus.sae.org/standards/ams4050k-aluminum-alloy-plate-62zn-23cu-22mg-012zr-7050-t7451-solution-heat-treated-stress-relieved-overaged)


## Read a property table correctly


Before comparing numbers, check whether the table reports typical properties, specification minimums or design allowables. Also check temper, thickness, test direction and units. The same alloy can have different acceptance requirements across those conditions. A generic chart cannot establish the allowable stress for a flight component.


[Kaiser Aluminum: 7050 technical data](https://online.kaiseraluminum.com/depot/PublicProductInformation/Document/1016/Kaiser_Aluminum_7050_Sheet_Coil_and_Plate.pdf)


## Turn the drawing into an order


If the available option differs from the drawing, resolve that difference before ordering. A supplier’s example certificate shows how documentation is organized; the certificate for your assigned material establishes what was actually supplied.


-


Copy the alloy, temper, product form and specification revision exactly.
-


Identify thickness, cut dimensions, quantity and grain direction.
-


Allow for the saw-cut tolerance and subsequent finish machining.
-


Include required inspection and origin documentation before selecting material.
-


Confirm the delivery location and required date against the quoted offer.
